mainEntity.name: What is the difference between standard and custom interior finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard interior finishes refer to common, readily available materials and designs often chosen for their cost-effectiveness and quick installation. Custom finishes, conversely, involve unique designs, bespoke materials, or personalized specifications tailored precisely to a client's preferences and space. The main difference lies in personalization and cost; custom options offer unique aesthetics and functionality but typically come at a higher price point and longer lead times due to their specialized nature.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard finishes are common and cost-effective, while custom finishes are unique designs and materials tailored to specific preferences. Custom options offer personalization but at a higher cost and longer lead time.
